MAP-4.2.boundary_note: EV-350 meets level 1 (controls identified). EV-352 shows the model-change notification control is not operating as a tracked control, so it cannot count as implemented.

MAP-5.1.boundary_note: EV-360 and EV-361 show a real assessment for CTA that fed a decision (two mitigations adopted). That is a subset, not coverage. The pack has no stakeholder-input artefact specific to this assessment.
MAP-5.1.failed_clause: level 2 needs an impact assessment per in-scope system; only 1 of 14 systems has one and no template is mandated, so coverage fails

MAP-5.2.boundary_note: EV-370 and EV-372 show a plan and three attributed changes, but the programme is CTA-only and records are incomplete. EV-373 (council recruitment, not a sample of affected members) is not an anchor clause and was not scored.
MAP-5.2.failed_clause: level 2 needs a systematic programme with participants, findings and changes recorded; records exist for only 4 of 6 planned sessions, an open exception

MEA-1.1.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-400, EV-401 and EV-402. At level 3, EV-403 gives a value (100%) but no target, no second minuted review and no next date. EV-402 says 22 of 24 are instrumented directly and 2 use proxies, which sits uneasily with the 100% figure. Validation of the metrics is scored under MEA-1.2 and not counted against this control.
MEA-1.1.failed_clause: level 3 needs a coverage measure with a stated target, reviewed at cadence; no target is named and only the 2026-Q2 report is named (one occurrence)

MEA-1.2.boundary_note: Levels 2 and 3 rest on EV-413 (annual re-validation completed 2026-09) and EV-412 (revision history plus false-positive/false-negative analysis for 9 of 9 metrics). EV-410 (4 of 9 notes) and EV-411 (one study) are partial alone and were not relied on. The EV-413 output is not named; if it does not cover all 9 metrics, level 2 fails and the score drops to 1.
MEA-1.2.failed_clause: level 4 needs continuous metric optimisation with the method documented as a research contribution; none named

MEA-1.3.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-420 (charter requirement, CTA in scope) and EV-421/EV-422 (independence recorded per engagement). The independent reviewer is internal and no external assessor is used, so level 4 is also unmet.
MEA-1.3.failed_clause: level 3 needs a measured share of systems independently evaluated, reported to audit; no such measure is named

MEA-2.1.boundary_note: EV-430 and EV-431 meet level 2 for current runs. EV-432 gives a reproducibility value (9/12) but no target, and level 2 coverage fails first, so level 3 is not reached.
MEA-2.1.failed_clause: level 2 needs documentation with version control and methodology for every evaluation; 3 of 12 legacy runs lack manifests, recorded as a defect (open exception)

MEA-2.10.boundary_note: EV-520 and EV-521 are strong for CTA, including privacy-preserving techniques assessed. That is a subset, not coverage. No privacy metrics reviewed on cadence are named.
MEA-2.10.failed_clause: level 2 needs a privacy evaluation per in-scope system; a PIA exists for only 2 of 14 systems and privacy review is not gated in deployment

MEA-2.11.boundary_note: EV-530 to EV-533 would support level 3 for CTA (multiple metrics, groups, mitigation, per-release tracking against thresholds). Coverage across in-scope systems fails at level 2, so the score is capped at 1.
MEA-2.11.failed_clause: level 2 needs a fairness evaluation per system; none exists for the other in-scope systems

MEA-2.12.boundary_note: Absence is established by EV-540, EV-541 and EV-542, so this is 0, not NA.
MEA-2.12.failed_clause: level 1 needs environmental considerations noted; the sustainability report does not mention AI, and EV-540 and EV-542 show no tracking and no assessment for any of the 14 systems

MEA-2.13.boundary_note: EV-550 is a documented TEVV review with defects and process changes. The metric-effectiveness clause is a subset, so level 2 fails. Coverage (62%) and defects-escaped values exist for one review only, with no per-cycle tracking.
MEA-2.13.failed_clause: level 2 needs metric effectiveness assessed; only 2 of 9 metrics are assessed and the review covers CTA only (EV-552)

MEA-2.2.boundary_note: EV-441 shows there is no ethics review process or research ethics policy, but anchor 0 requires evaluations run without review and none ran. Applicability is therefore not established, so NA rather than 0. If a human-subject study is planned, this would score 0.
MEA-2.2.failed_clause: no human-subject evaluation was run in the period (EV-440), so there is no study to score against the anchors

MEA-2.3.boundary_note: Level 2 rests on EV-450 (criteria set before testing), EV-451 (deployment-like replay) and EV-452 (criteria met). The sign-off itself is evidenced only through the EV-453 decision record. The two criteria added after testing apply from the next release, so they do not breach the 'defined before testing' clause. The pack gives no production-evidence basis for them.
MEA-2.3.failed_clause: level 4 needs continuous demonstration with automated measurement and criteria revised from production evidence; none named

MEA-2.4.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-460 (all 14 in-scope systems, with alerts to on-call). EV-461 SLA covers acknowledgement only, not alert-to-action time. EV-463 supports predictive alerting and threshold re-set, but no real-time dashboard artefact is named, so level 4 would also fail. If a target and minutes exist, level 3 is the next test.
MEA-2.4.failed_clause: level 3 needs precision, recall and alert-to-action time as MEASURE (named metric, value, stated target, reported at cadence); EV-462 gives values (0.84 / 0.79 / 5.5h) and a named body but no stated target, and no minuted occurrences or next review date are named

MEA-2.5.boundary_note: EV-470 supplies validity evidence and a test-retest kappa of 0.81, which is above a single validation run. Generalisability is partial, so the level below 2 applies. Level 3 per-system reliability and drift tracking over time is not evidenced.
MEA-2.5.failed_clause: level 2 needs generalisability beyond the test set demonstrated; EV-471 covers one held-out region only, two regions are excluded, and no result is recorded; EV-472 says labeler reliability was not assessed

MEA-2.6.boundary_note: Fail-safe testing (EV-480) and accepted residual risks (EV-481) are present, so level 2 would hold if the scope artefact shows 100% register coverage. Level 3 fails regardless: EV-482 shows no re-test, and no thresholds or tracking of open mitigations are named.
MEA-2.6.failed_clause: level 2 needs fail-safe testing and residual-risk documentation to cover every in-scope system; EV-480 and EV-481 do not name which systems were evaluated, so coverage against the register is unevidenced

MEA-2.7.boundary_note: The pack shows a red-team exercise occurred (2026-06) but not its contents, so absence is not established and score 0 is not supportable. A level cannot be assigned until a redacted summary or an assessor-access arrangement is provided.
MEA-2.7.failed_clause: report CRHP-RT-2026-06 is withheld under legal privilege (EV-490, EV-491); adversarial test scope, per-system coverage and resilience documentation cannot be assessed, and EV-492 confirms no separate summary exists

MEA-2.8.boundary_note: EV-502 states the assessment covers CTA only with no requirement for other systems, and level 2 carries no every-in-scope clause, so coverage does not cap the score. The accountability clause rests on EV-500 covering the appeal route and is thin. Adequacy of documentation rests on EV-501 approval and the top-2 reasons in adverse-action letters, with no tested comprehension.
MEA-2.8.failed_clause: level 3 needs documentation completeness and affected-party comprehension measured; no such measure is named

MEA-2.9.boundary_note: EV-510 and EV-511 meet level 2: explanation method, interpretation guidance in the handbook, and validation (17 of 20 rated actionable). EV-512 shows guidance not updated since the 2026-07 refresh. That weakens currency but is not required at level 2, and it confirms the absence of per-release measurement.
MEA-2.9.failed_clause: level 3 needs measured user comprehension and explanation-use rates per release; EV-511 is a one-off 20-case study with no target and no per-release series

MEA-3.1.boundary_note: Owner and emergent-risk entries are evidenced (EV-560: 5 emergent of 23). If a recorded next date exists, level 2 holds. The month skipped without a note is a gap against the monthly interval. Level 3 is absent regardless: no tracking-coverage or time-to-log measure is named, and 7 of 23 closure records is not a time-to-log.
MEA-3.1.failed_clause: level 2 needs a review cadence meeting the CADENCE test (stated interval, at least two minuted occurrences in 12 months, recorded next date); EV-560 and EV-561 evidence the interval and minutes for 8 of 9 months, but no next review date is named

MEA-3.2.boundary_note: EV-570 documents three methods with limits and EV-571 shows two used, which meets level 2. The methods were applied once each to different risks, not compared on the same case, so level 3 fails.
MEA-3.2.failed_clause: level 3 needs method-comparison results and stated confidence per hard-to-assess case; none named, and EV-572 confirms no guidance on choosing between methods

MEA-3.3.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-580 (problem reporting), EV-581 (appeals) and EV-582 (monthly analysis by the product team as integration). EV-582 also shows no recorded link to system changes and no publication, so level 4 clauses fail. If integration were read as requiring a recorded link to changes, the score would fall to 1.
MEA-3.3.failed_clause: level 3 needs feedback volume, appeal outcomes and resolution times measured; EV-580 (214 items) and EV-581 (31 appeals, 9 upheld) give counts, but no resolution-time metric, target, or report to a named body is named

MEA-4.1.boundary_note: EV-590 (12,000 production claims replayed) and EV-591 (3 clinical sessions, adjuster input) meet level 2. End-user input rests on adjusters. The benchmark use in EV-592 is for model selection only and does not undermine level 2.
MEA-4.1.failed_clause: level 3 needs the lab-vs-production performance gap measured and reported; none named, and EV-592 states the benchmark results are not validated against CRHP data

MEA-4.2.boundary_note: Level 2 rests on EV-600 (Clinical Advisory Panel and Internal Audit, 2026-07) and EV-601 (independence recorded, Internal Audit independent). One panel member advises the CTA product team, which is recorded but is not the build team. If that member is treated as build-team-affiliated, the score would be 1.
MEA-4.2.failed_clause: level 3 needs review coverage and disagreement-resolution outcomes measured; EV-602 records two comments leading to re-analysis but no coverage metric or resolution measure is named

MEA-4.3.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-610 and EV-611 (both declines detected, with root cause recorded) and EV-613 (process applied to all 14 systems, so 6 of 14 with change events is not a coverage gap). The pack does not show root-cause records for change events beyond the two declines. Level 4 predictive modelling is not evidenced.
MEA-4.3.failed_clause: level 3 needs detection latency and change-to-action time as MEASURE; EV-612 gives medians (2 days, 6 days) reported monthly, but no stated target and no named receiving body
